rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the degree or quality of being soft, especially for materials and objects.

example.english: The softness of this sofa is just right, so it’s comfortable to sit on.
example.traditional: 呢張梳化嘅柔軟度啱啱好，坐落去好舒服。
